name: selogic-codex-watchdog
description: Independent completion guard for Codex: catches missing tests, likely secrets, incomplete review and scope risks before a coding task finishes.

interface.shortDescription: Final-pass guard for Codex coding work
interface.longDescription: Adds a lightweight independent completion check to Codex. It tracks task complexity and test execution, scans diffs for likely secrets, and can request one additional pass before Codex finishes.
